\chapter{Build the Residence Label and Values}
\label{ch:pa-form-residence-runway}
\hlchaptermodality{18}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise and copy the Gurmukhi residence label and two separately practised neutral values.}

The learner assembles the residence label and copies two neutral values after each new Gurmukhi piece has received its own bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[ra]{\pa{ਰ} — one new base for the residence label}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-ra}



\begin{quote}
Find the familiar short-vowel mark \textbf{\pa{ਿ}}. Today adds only one base letter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਰ}} slowly twice. Say \emph{ra}. Then place \textbf{\pa{ਿ}} before it once: \textbf{\pa{ਰਿ}}.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Write \textbf{\pa{ਰ}} once without the model. Compare only the base shape and repair one difference.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after this one new base.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[i]{\pa{ਇ} — one independent vowel}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-independent-i}



\begin{quote}
Write the new base \textbf{\pa{ਰ}} once. Leave a finger-width of space beside it.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਇ}} slowly twice. It stands on its own; it is not the attached mark \textbf{\pa{ਿ}}.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to \textbf{\pa{ਇ}}, cover it, and write it once. Repair only the new shape.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No word is scored yet.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[rihāish]{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼} — assemble the residence label}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-label}



\begin{quote}
Touch the pieces in order: \textbf{\pa{ਰਿ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਹਾ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਇ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one label}
Join \textbf{\pa{ਰਿ} + \pa{ਹਾ} + \pa{ਇ} + \pa{ਸ਼} = \pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}}. On a form, \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}} labels the residence line. Copy the label once and leave its answer blank.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the label and say what information belongs there. Do not add a value yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The familiar spoken word \textbf{\pa{ਰਹਿਣਾ}} can remind you of living somewhere; only the form label is scored here.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ḍa]{\pa{ਡ} — one new base for a residence value}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-dda}



\begin{quote}
Find the familiar nasal mark \textbf{\pa{ੰ}}. Today adds one base letter beneath the line.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਡ}} slowly twice. Say \emph{ḍa}. Do not build the whole word yet.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and write \textbf{\pa{ਡ}} once. Repair only the base shape.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One new base is enough.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[piṇḍ]{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ} — assemble one residence value}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-village}



\begin{quote}
Touch \textbf{\pa{ਪ}}, then the pre-base \textbf{\pa{ਿ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ੰ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਡ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one value}
Build \textbf{\pa{ਪਿ} + \pa{ੰ} + \pa{ਡ} = \pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}. It means “village.” Copy \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}} once.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model, say the meaning, and write the value once. Reveal it and repair one piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Only this value is scored today.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[shahir]{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ} — assemble the other residence value}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-city}



\begin{quote}
Touch the known pieces \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}, \textbf{\pa{ਹਿ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਰ}} in order.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one value}
Join \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼} + \pa{ਹਿ} + \pa{ਰ} = \pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}. It means “city.” Copy \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}} once.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model, say the meaning, and write the value once. Repair only the first differing piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The two values remain separate until the next lesson.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[Practice]{The wellbeing exchange returns at R4}

\label{lesson:PA-R18-wellbeing-r4}



\begin{quote}
No new language. Keep this oral: listen, speak, then type only a record of what you already said.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{The exchange}
Ask, answer, and close once. Romanization records prior speech only; it earns no Gurmukhi reading or writing credit.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Say the three-turn exchange once more from meaning alone.
\end{tcolorbox}
